39:t_1:86.en:
$$甲児$$
「But according to $$ブルー$$, there are people there who can help us.」

39:t_1:87.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We'll find out what awaits us when we get there. Right, $n?」

39:t_1:90.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Are you still... worried about $$シンジ$$?」

39:t_1:92.en:
$n
「A $$時空震動$$ or dimensional quake hits, and people who were with us yesterday suddenly disappear... How long is this going to keep happening...?」

39:t_1:95.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$シンジ$$ and the people at $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ are missing, but I'm sure they're not dead. We'll see them again someday.」

39:t_1:96.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$アルト$$'s right. Let's focus on driving $$サイデリアル$$ off Earth first, so we can greet them with a smile when we meet again.」

39:t_1:98.en:
$$スズネ$$
($n's father and older sister were caught in a dimensional quake and lost their lives...)

39:t_1:99.en:
$$スズネ$$
(《$$テンシ$$》 caused that quake... We beat 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》, the $$時獄戦役$$ mastermind, but the 《$$血塗られた眼$$》 remained...)

39:t_1:100.en:
$$スズネ$$
(Those symptoms appear when $$テンシ$$ is nearby... If that's true, $n's fight...)

39:t_1:101.en:
$$正太郎$$
「First $n, and now Miss $$スズネ$$ is spacing out.」

39:t_1:102.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Huh... Oh... Well... I was thinking up an excuse for the $$ボランティア部$$'s absence from school during this mission...」

39:t_1:103.en:
$$さやか$$
「Thanks for all your hard work, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

39:t_1:104.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know it's a trouble, but we're counting on you.」

39:t_1:105.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Leave it to me. After all, whether you all advance to the next grade is at stake.」

39:t_1:108.en:
$n
「Then, Club President... Give us the usual orders.」

39:t_1:109.en:
$$アルト$$
「From the $$ボランティア部$$ President to all members! For now, our mission is cleaning and tidying this ship!」

39:t_1:110.en:
$$アルト$$
「We don't know what awaits us on $$翠の地球$$, but a messy living space means a messy mind! Let's get to it!」

39:t_1:114.en:
$$宗介$$
「I know. They won't let us advance so easily.」

39:t_2:4.en:
$$キャシー$$
「Captain! At this rate, the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will burn up from atmospheric friction!」

39:t_2:7.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「After transforming, we'll accelerate toward the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ at maximum speed and push its hull upward.」

39:t_2:8.en:
$$キャシー$$
「That's reckless! If we do that, the $$クォーター$$ will burn up first!」

39:t_2:9.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「There's plenty of debris around us. ...$$ボビー$$, transfer helm control to me.」

39:t_2:10.en:
$$ボビー$$
「OK, Boss! You're going to use your secret weapon!」

39:t_2:12.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$フォーメーション・ビッグウェンズデー$$! Here we go!!」

39:t_2:16.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Look, look, $$サーヤ$$, $$メルティ$$! Shooting stars!」

39:t_2:18.en:
$$メルティ$$
「But aren't there a few too many?」

39:t_2:19.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Don't worry about it. It's perfect for making a wish.」

39:t_2:21.en:
$$エイミー$$
「$$ベベル$$ heard from Dr. $$オルダム$$ that if you make a wish on a shooting star, it'll come true.」

39:t_2:22.en:
$$メルティ$$
「A hot guy! A hot guy, a hot guy!」

39:t_2:23.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Oh, $$メルティ$$... That's all you ever think about.」

39:t_2:24.en:
$$サーヤ$$
「What are you going to wish for, $$エイミー$$?」

39:t_2:26.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I guess... I wish for another good day tomorrow.」

39:t_2:28.en:
$$エイミー$$
「I wish for another good day tomorrow...!」

39:t_10:4.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you all right, $$ＡＧ$$? The $$ダナン$$ was shaking really badly.」

39:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are no problems at all. $$ジェフリー$$ rescued us with his incredible surfing and brought us through safely.」

39:t_10:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm not sure what that means, but as long as you're safe.」

39:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And your lesson to $$アル$$ on how to handle $$宗介$$ seems to have paid off right away, $$かなめ$$.」

39:t_10:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Ha ha... And all we did was chat.」

39:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, no... The results are reflected in our $$Ｚチップ$$s.」

39:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The amount... 50 Z. It isn't much now, but I'll add it to our stock, trusting it'll bear great fruit someday.」

39:t_10:11.en:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$ told me about you, but you really do love $$Ｚチップ$$s, don't you?」

39:t_10:12.en:
$$かなめ$$
「If you don't mind, could you show me an actual one?」

39:t_10:14.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's beautiful... It almost feels like my mind could be drawn into it...」

39:t_10:17.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm fine, I'm fine. I just had a little headache.」

39:t_10:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's a relief... If anything happened to you, $$かなめ$$, I couldn't face $$宗介$$ either.」

39:t_10:19.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You sure make a big deal out of things, $$ＡＧ$$.」

39:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please prove that you're feeling well.」

39:t_10:21.en:
$$かなめ$$
「All right, all right. $$アルト$$ and the others told me how this goes.」

39:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's get fired up for another day of...」

39:t_10:23.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Business, business! And for good measure, big business!」

39:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for that extra-special service. Just what I'd expect from a 《$$ウィスパード$$》.」

39:t_10:25.en:
$$かなめ$$
「What... How did you know that...!?」

39:t_10:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Heh heh... I have my ways. Don't underestimate a dimensional merchant's information network.」

39:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Yes... Your presence will have a major effect on what happens from here on...)

39:t_10:32.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Are you all right, $$ＡＧ$$? The $$ダナン$$ was shaking really badly.」

39:t_10:33.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There are no problems at all. $$ジェフリー$$ rescued us with his incredible surfing and brought us through safely.」

notes: Suzune recalls Hibiki's bereavement; his fight remains deliberately unfinished in her thought. Jeffrey's debris surfing rescues Danaan. Melty wishes for a handsome man; Amy wishes for another peaceful good day. AG and Kaname share the shop chant across rows.
